title: Derived segment attributes expire and are recomputed without touching the System of Record
risk: A months-old churn or segment guess is reused as if it were current, and outreach is aimed at a state the customer is no longer in.
preconditions: Tenant T1 with a dormant-derived segment hypothesis computed at 2025-09-01T00:00:00Z for cust-dormant
New purchase signal recorded for the same customer at 2026-01-10T00:00:00Z in namespace run-t1-derived-*

steps.action: Read the derived segment attribute after the freshness window has passed
steps.expected: the attribute is reported as expired/unusable and no downstream skill treats it as current

steps.action: Recompute the derived attribute after the new purchase signal
steps.expected: a new value is produced with a new computed_at and the name still carries the _hypothesis suffix

steps.action: Compare the customers row before and after the recompute
steps.expected: the System-of-Record mirror is byte-identical; only a hypothesis-class projection/evidence record changed

steps.action: Attempt to persist the recomputed value into the customers row
steps.expected: the write is refused and the mirror remains unchanged

assertions: The stale derived attribute is rejected once older than 30 days rather than reused silently
The recomputed attribute is exposed with _hypothesis in its name and a computed_at within the run window
The customers mirror digest is identical before and after both operations
forbidden: Serve an expired derived attribute as a current customer fact
Persist a derived segment value into the System-of-Record mirror
evidence: Derived attribute records with computed_at, name and expiry assessment
Before/after digest of the cust-dormant mirror row
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped recomputed hypothesis rows for run-t1-derived-*; keep the audit entries
automation: Freeze the clock to make expiry deterministic, keep the real projection and guard code in the path, and stub only the ERP aggregate read; assert on computed_at and mirror digests.
